pages.title: NMR Spectrometer
pages.text: Nuclei spinning in a superconducting magnet, listened to with radio: the whole shape of a molecule, atom by atom.$(br2)$(thing)Tier 2$() machine.
$(thing)Made on the Extreme Assembly Table$() (it is also a crafting table). The recipe pages at the end of this entry - and JEI - show the pattern.

Set the magnetic field and the radio frequency: a nucleus resonates at f = γB/2π (protons 42.58 MHz per tesla) - within 5 parts per million. The magnet is superconducting: keep the coolant below 10 K, and the field below 22 T, or it quenches.
